ideas.pitch: A dashboard integrating tightly with the IcyPluto platform to analyze a brand's AI visibility and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) performance against top three competitors, automatically outputting a 3-month actionable content roadmap.
ideas.title: IcyPulse Brand Intelligence & Competitor Gap Visualizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly leverages the core platform required by the hackathon (IcyPluto) to solve the exact brand analysis and gap identification problem requested in the challenge brief.

ideas.pitch: An agentic tool leveraging IcyPluto's insights to scan trending audio and topics on Instagram and TikTok, auto-generating script hooks, storyboard assets, and caption frameworks tailored to the assigned brand's voice.
ideas.title: ReelGenie: AI Short-Form Video & Trend Hijacker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Tackles short-form video content and reels, which are critical for 3-month brand visibility strategies, using automated multi-agent workflows.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered geographic and semantic search optimization tool designed to ensure the assigned brand ranks prominently in conversational AI search engines and local queries over the 3-month strategy window.
ideas.title: GeoPulse: Localized GEO & Search Intent Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses heavily on GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) and SEO strategies mentioned in the hackathon brief, an advanced angle most traditional marketing teams will miss.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous agent platform that scrapes niche creators, analyzes their engagement authenticity against the assigned brand's demographic gaps, and simulates campaign ROI using predictive modeling.
ideas.title: CreatorMatch AI: Automated Influencer Collab & ROI Predictor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines hard engineering (predictive modeling and scraper pipelines) with influencer collaborations to present a foolproof 3-month growth plan.

ideas.pitch: A rapid experimentation sandbox where teams can plug in performance marketing campaigns, simulate click-through rates, and deploy automated community-building engagement loops for the assigned brand.
ideas.title: GrowthExperiment OS: Automated A/B Testing & Funnel Simulator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses performance marketing and growth experiments directly through a functional dashboard that proves the feasibility of the 3-month strategy.
